claims.claim_text: Revenue recognized at point-in-time for product shipments; over-time for multi-year service contracts using input-method progress measurement.
Consolidated FY2024 revenue $3,290M, +6.2% YoY; gross margin expanded 80 bps; operating cash flow $642M against net income $618M (1.04x conversion).
FY2025 consolidated revenue growth guided 4-6%; Adjusted EBITDA margin to expand 30-60 bps; capex $290-310M; assumes stable raw-material costs and no customer-share-shift events.

Warranty reserve sensitivity of plus-or-minus $12M for plus-or-minus 100 bps change in claim-rate assumption; pension PBO sensitivity of plus-or-minus $28M for plus-or-minus 25 bps change in discount rate.
Part III items 10-14 incorporated by reference from the proxy statement to be filed within 120 days of fiscal year-end.

Industrial Components grew 9.1% with margin expansion; Services grew 4.4% with stable margins; Specialty Alloys merchant-market revenue declined 2.0% but captive supply continues to support Components margin.
Top three OEM customers represented approximately 38% of consolidated revenue; specialty-alloy raw-material supply concentrated in two upstream producers.
